hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""' | { IFS= read -r f || f=''; case "$f" in */scripts/*.py|scripts/*.py) if command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1; then ruff check --fix "$f" && ruff format "$f"; elif command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then uv run ruff check --fix "$f" && uv run ruff format "$f"; else printf '%s\n' 'Ruff hook requires ruff or uv.' >&2; exit 127; fi ;; esac; }
